# Track GitHub Code Quality enablement changes in the audit log

## What Changed

GitHub Code Quality now writes an audit log event whenever someone enables, disables, or changes its settings on a repository. Three new events give you that history: repo.code_quality_enabled records when…

## Why It Matters to a CSA

This may change the workload security posture or required controls.
